automated_os_patch_management_enabled.title: Automated OS Patch Management Enabled
automated_os_patch_management_enabled.description: Whether operating-system updates are deployed across enterprise assets through an automated patch-management capability on a configured schedule (CIS 7.3). Secure/present value is true.

automated_application_patch_management_e.title: Automated Application Patch Management Enabled
automated_application_patch_management_e.description: Whether third-party/application software updates are deployed via automated patch management, not only the OS (CIS 7.4). Secure/present value is true.

os_patch_deployment_cadence_days.title: OS Patch Deployment Cadence (Days)
os_patch_deployment_cadence_days.description: Interval in days at which the automated patch job runs. CIS 7 requires <=30; secure value is <=30.

emergency_out_of_band_patch_path.title: Emergency Out-of-Band Patch Path
emergency_out_of_band_patch_path.description: Whether a defined emergency/out-of-band maintenance plan fast-tracks patches outside the routine cycle for actively-exploited vulnerabilities (M1051, ~24h). True when present.

critical_patch_window_days.title: Critical Patch SLA Window (Days)
critical_patch_window_days.description: Maximum days the risk-based SLA allows between a critical/actively-exploited patch becoming available and being deployed. Lower is more secure; secure value <=7.

documented_vulnerability_and_remediation.title: Documented Vulnerability & Remediation Process
documented_vulnerability_and_remediation.description: Whether a documented risk-based vulnerability-management and remediation process exists and is reviewed on cadence (CIS 7.1/7.2). It governs the SLA and emergency path and is a required input to compliance reporting.

patch_coverage_of_inventory_complete.title: Patch Coverage Reconciled to Inventory
patch_coverage_of_inventory_complete.description: Patch coverage is reconciled against the authoritative asset (CIS 1) and software (CIS 2) inventory so every in-scope asset is enrolled. True when coverage gaps are near zero.

firmware_and_network_device_patch_covera.title: Firmware & Network Device Patch Coverage
firmware_and_network_device_patch_covera.description: Firmware and network/edge appliances (NGFW, VPN gateways, switches, NAS) are tracked and patched, not only servers/endpoints. True when in scope and current.

third_party_and_agent_patch_coverage.title: Third-Party & Agent Patch Coverage
third_party_and_agent_patch_coverage.description: Third-party/dependency software and management/security agents (including the patch agent itself) are enrolled and current. True when tracked and updated.

vulnerability_scanning_feeds_prioritizat.title: Vulnerability Scanning Feeds Prioritization
vulnerability_scanning_feeds_prioritizat.description: Automated vulnerability scanning is in place AND findings are connected to risk-based remediation/patch prioritization (CIS 7.5/7.6/7.7). Fires when true.

internal_scan_interval_days.title: Internal Vulnerability Scan Interval (Days)
internal_scan_interval_days.description: Maximum interval in days between authenticated internal vulnerability scans. CIS 7.5 requires <=90; lower is more secure.

external_scan_interval_days.title: External Vulnerability Scan Interval (Days)
external_scan_interval_days.description: Maximum interval in days between external-facing-asset vulnerability scans. CIS 7.6 requires <=30; lower is more secure.

remediation_rate_measured_between_scans.title: Remediation Rate Measured Between Scans
remediation_rate_measured_between_scans.description: Supporting evidence (CIS 7.7) that remediation rate is measured between consecutive scans. Context only.

patch_tested_in_staging_before_productio.title: Patch Tested in Staging Before Production
patch_tested_in_staging_before_productio.description: Patches pass a documented test/staging ring before broad production rollout (NIST SP 800-40r4). True when present.

patch_rollback_path_exists.title: Patch Rollback Path Exists
patch_rollback_path_exists.description: A documented rollback/recovery to a known-good configuration lets a bad patch be reverted (NIST SP 800-128). True when present.

patch_change_control_enforced.title: Patch Change Control Enforced
patch_change_control_enforced.description: Patch deployments flow through documented change control with security-impact analysis and authorization (NIST CM-3). True when a managed, auditable change process governs every push.

update_source_integrity_verified.title: Update Source Integrity Verified
update_source_integrity_verified.description: Patches are delivered only from an integrity-verified, signed update source (NIST CM-14). True when packages are signed and signature-verified before install.

patch_compliance_reporting_and_metrics.title: Patch Compliance Reporting & Metrics
patch_compliance_reporting_and_metrics.description: The program produces regular patch-compliance metrics — percent patched, MTTR, remediation rate between scans (CIS 7.7; M1051). True when produced and reviewed.
